title: SmartThings Device Health Flap Rate
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=smartthings:schema device_health=*
transaction device_id maxspan=5m
where eventcount()>4
stats count as flaps by device_id
description: Detects SmartThings devices oscillating ONLINE/OFFLINE within minutes.
value: Surfacing smartthings device health flap rate helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant smart home platforms & automation export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you when smartthings device health flap rate matters for your routine.
